finalists.label: Hemangiopericytoma
finalists.why: This candidate has the most specific and decisive findings, including a left tentorial extra-axial enhancing mass with adjacent parenchymal hemorrhage and histopathological examination demonstrating spindle cells forming masses with branching ectatic vasculature.

finalists.label: Hemangioma
finalists.why: This candidate has strong evidence, including a left tentorial extra-axial enhancing mass with adjacent parenchymal hemorrhage and histopathological examination demonstrating spindle cells forming masses with branching ectatic vasculature, with no significant findings against it.

frontier_selector.why: The champion, Hemangiopericytoma, is chosen because it has the most decisive findings, including scattered S100-positive cells and up to 20 mitoses per ten high-power fields, which are not explained by the runner-up, Hemangioma.
